Registers the 16 BR-FUND-04 settle.* keys at the end of the registry (per platform taobao / jd / pdd / meituan, config.business, editable; approved defaults D-S1 to D-S3) with frozen integer ranges on the 11 integer keys (bill_day 22-28 from 08, lower bounds elsewhere) checked by configValueFits on save, batch and rollback; the existing 29 keys behave as before. Seed defaults appended to db/seeds/0001_config-defaults.sql (a re-runnable seed, not a migration) with values copied from 08. The frozen F1-10e tests accept the whole group since F1-02zi (#966); F1-02zt tightens. No amount is computed here. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
